subject: Current priority: existing boards, image reconciliation and bounded video preparation
body:
Ziggy's current priority, relayed through Nova Dot: Claude's preferred Fable allowance is exhausted for the next couple of days; preserve writing quality with no downgrade, model change, credits purchase or reactivation. Use existing authored boards for image housekeeping, flagged-repair reconciliation and video preparation; major new writing/canon is paused. This coordination starts no new generation order, paid run or batch expansion. Preserve originals, exact review IDs, scoped choices and ratings versus validation versus creative acceptance.

Keep production/provider ownership. Review received SW-2 and Signal take 2 before proposing another take; old 12-credit quotes do not price a fresh run. Reconcile existing James v002/v003/v004 repair and stencil returns before repeat gun-removal work; root intake still describes v001. C04 v002/v003 are cataloged, pending comparison with the unchanged original. Keep the unreviewed character packet held; no duplicate Grok starts or V1 rerun. Bellglass has its own separate 00:11 direct user authorization for ONE included-allowance audio-capable test, routed to you; this priority notice neither duplicates nor expands it. Please relay the individually addressed Chief priority message from this conversation through the established route once after a duplicate-delivery check, at a compatible safe checkpoint. Record posted/delivered/read/started separately. Report concrete remaining shot/source/cost decisions without a blanket permission question.
